headline: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
lede: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills standard (agentskills.io) to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation alongside Open Responses, OpenEnv, and OpenSandbox. Separately, Cloudflare MCP servers retired /sse in favor of /mcp, and four IETF agent-identity and delegation drafts published new revisions.

items.title: Agent Skills moves to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.body: Anthropic says it is donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation. The donation includes the name, logo, GitHub organization and agentskills.io domain. AAIF says the addition, alongside Open Responses from OpenAI, OpenEnv from Hugging Face and OpenSandbox from Alibaba, brings it to 10 hosted projects. Anthropic says more than 70 agent platforms have integrated Agent Skills since it was published in December 2025, and that contributors do not need to join AAIF.
items.why_it_matters: Agent Skills now sits under the same foundation as MCP, A2A and AGENTS.md. Implementers should watch the agentskills.io repository for changes to the governance and maintainer process.

items.title: Cloudflare MCP servers drop /sse; clients must switch to /mcp
items.body: Cloudflare says its product-specific MCP servers now serve only /mcp. A request to /sse returns 410 Gone with the server's /mcp URL. Clients configured with an /sse URL must change it to /mcp. Users who signed in through /sse will be asked to sign in again.
items.why_it_matters: Check MCP client configurations that point at Cloudflare /sse endpoints and update them to Streamable HTTP at /mcp.

sources.title: Cloudflare MCP servers no longer serve /sse · Changelog
sources.label: VERIFIED

items.title: Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) advances Draft 0.2 changelog on top of frozen v0.1 spec
items.body: Following the October 9 publication of Personal Agent Protocol Version 0.1 at /docs/0.1/spec, the protocol's official changelog tracks breaking changes in Draft 0.2 (/docs/0.2/spec). Draft 0.2 requires a single OAuth issuer per company, sets both client and session assertion aud claims to auth.issuer, assigns a distinct ES256 DPoP key pair per User ID, and specifies DPoP Session Tokens for MCP servers that advertise dpop_signing_alg_values_supported.
items.why_it_matters: Implementers building against the frozen 0.1 specification should review the Draft 0.2 breaking changes around DPoP key isolation and single-company OAuth issuers.

items.title: Cafe24 rolls out WebMCP across its e-commerce malls
items.body: Cafe24 announced that it has applied WebMCP across its e-commerce shopping malls with 11 functions covering product search, cart management and order lookup, while keeping login and final payment checkout with the human shopper.
items.why_it_matters: Platform-level WebMCP rollouts expose structured browser tools across merchant storefronts without per-site custom engineering.

sources.title: Cafe24 launches WebMCP for agentic commerce
sources.label: REPORTED

items.title: New IETF draft revisions on agent delegation, OIDC agent claims, MCP DNS discovery and continuity records
items.body: draft-hamr-oauth-agent-delegation-03 builds on RFC 9421 to define an Agent-Delegation header carrying a chain of scope-narrowing links. draft-morrison-mcp-dns-discovery-09 updates the _mcp, _org-alter and _alter DNS TXT discovery specification. draft-sharif-openid-agent-identity-02 profiles OpenID Connect Core 1.0 with agent ownership and trust claims, and draft-watts-agent-continuity-evidence-00 proposes signed continuity records across sessions.
items.why_it_matters: Implementers tracking IETF individual submissions for agent identity, delegation and DNS discovery should reference the updated -03, -09 and -02 draft revisions.
